The church has many chairs for comfort and a quiet seating area.
We are an accessible building with a lift to access the sanctuary area where we host all of these groups.
attributes.hours_of_access__opening_hours: Chatty Cafe - Fridays, drop in between 10am until 11.30am. The church is open also on Sunday mornings for a service 10.30 to 11.30 after which is served hot drinks. Thursdays 10.30 -12am - Communion service, with refreshments afterwards. Polka tots Toddler Group is held on Fridays for carers and parents with young children. Drop in between 1.30-3.30pm
